Chloe — quick thoughts from the sales side:

- I think Aurora is reasonable on limits. To keep momentum, let's propose the following as our standard ask (and be prepared to accept minor deviations with a field-level exception):
  • Commercial General Liability (CGL): $2,000,000 per occurrence / $4,000,000 aggregate
  • Professional Liability (E&O): $5,000,000 per claim / $5,000,000 aggregate (claims-made acceptable with retroactive date)
  • Cyber/Privacy Liability: $5,000,000 aggregate (claims-made)
  • Business Auto Liability: $1,000,000 combined single limit

- On additional insured: offer blanket Additional Insured for CGL only (ISO CG 20 26 or equivalent). Do NOT extend blanket AI to E&O or Cyber. If Aurora insists, we can ask them to provide named endorsement limited to Redwood Inference and include a waiver of subrogation on primary basis.

- COI delivery: suggest 14 days after countersignature; if they need execution-to-start earlier, allow a 30-day grace but require written confirmation and carrier binding notice.

If legal pushes back on any of those positions, I can escalate to the account exec for a commercial concession. Happy to join a 15-min call with Aurora.

Thanks — Aditya
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Chloe / team,

See legal guidance and proposed response text below. I added specific redline snippets you can paste into the thread with Aurora.

Key positions (summary):
- Additional Insured: Redwood will accept Additional Insured endorsements for Commercial General Liability only. For clarity, the endorsement must be issued on a form equivalent to ISO CG 20 26 (Blanket Additional Insured) or a Named Endorsement naming "Redwood Inference, its officers, directors, employees, and agents". Redwood will not accept blanket Additional Insured status for Professional Liability (E&O) or Cyber policies.
- Coverage minimums (Redwood required baseline):
  • Commercial General Liability: $2,000,000 per occurrence / $4,000,000 aggregate
  • Professional Liability (E&O): $5,000,000 per claim / $5,000,000 aggregate (claims-made acceptable if retroactive date precedes contract effective date)
  • Cyber/Privacy Liability: $5,000,000 aggregate (claims-made; carrier must provide retroactive date or discovery wording)
  • Business Auto: $1,000,000 CSL
- Occurrence vs Claims-Made: CGL must be occurrence form. E&O may be claims-made with a retroactive date on or before contract effective date. Cyber may be claims-made but must include retroactive/extended reporting period or discovery language that effectively covers prior acts during the contract term.
- Waiver of Subrogation: Redwood requires a waiver of subrogation in favor of Redwood on CGL and Auto where permitted by law; waiver for E&O/Cyber acceptable if carrier confirms in endorsement.
- Certificate and endorsement receipt: COI and required endorsements must be received by security@redwood.com within 14 calendar days of countersignature. If Aurora cannot meet 14 days, we can allow up to 30 days with a documented interim binder or email confirmation from the carrier evidencing coverage.

Proposed response text you can send to Aurora:

---begin---
Hi Jane — thanks for the note and the certificate template. Redwood's legal team confirms the following positions that resolve the insurance exhibit:

1) Coverage minimums we require are: CGL $2,000,000 / $4,000,000 agg; E&O $5,000,000 / $5,000,000 (claims-made acceptable with retroactive date); Cyber $5,000,000 agg (claims-made acceptable with retroactive coverage); Auto $1,000,000 CSL.

2) Additional Insured: Redwood will accept Additional Insured endorsements for Commercial General Liability only (ISO CG 20 26 or equivalent). Redwood will not accept blanket additional insured status on Professional Liability or Cyber policies. If Aurora's carriers cannot issue the blanket endorsement for CGL, a named endorsement specifically naming "Redwood Inference" will suffice.

3) Waiver of Subrogation: Redwood requires a waiver of subrogation on CGL and Auto where permitted by law. We will accept waiver language for other lines if the carrier confirms it in the endorsement.

4) Certificates and endorsements: please email the COI and required endorsements to security@redwood.com within 14 calendar days after countersignature. If you need additional time, provide a carrier-issued binder or email confirmation within 14 days and deliver the full documentation within 30 days.

If these positions are acceptable, please confirm and provide the COI/policy numbers and endorsements. Happy to hop on a short call if you'd like to discuss.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
---end---

If Aurora pushes to have blanket AI for E&O or Cyber, we should decline and ask for a named endorsement limited to Redwood. Any exception to that needs VP Sales sign-off (Vivek / Chloe).

Laura
